name: Naralex
summary: Naralex is a night elf druid who sought to restore the parched Barrens to a lush forest using the powers of the Emerald Dream. Instead, his slumber was overtaken by a dark nightmare, twisting the Wailing Caverns beneath the earth and turning his followers into venomous fiends.

sections.title: A Vision of Green
sections.body: Long before the Great Sundering, the sun-scorched plains of the Barrens were once a vibrant forest. Viewing this loss as a tragedy, Naralex journeyed south from Darnassus with a cohort of devoted disciples to reverse the drought. Deep beneath the savannah, he discovered an intricate subterranean network of underground springs and rushing geysers, naming them the Wailing Caverns after the howling wind and steam that moaned through the rock. He believed that by entering a deep trance and channeling the pristine energies of the Emerald Dream into these subterranean waters, the life-giving flow would reach the surface and cause the entire wasteland to bloom.

sections.title: The Waking Nightmare
sections.body: Naralex seated himself in deep meditation deep within the subterranean caverns, but his noble design collapsed the moment his consciousness touched the realm of the Dream. Rather than finding peaceful fonts of wild nature, his mind was ensnared by a malignant, encroaching corruption—an Emerald Nightmare. The festering corruption seized the sleeping druid's body, transforming him into an open conduit through which dark energies bled into the living world. The pristine springs turned foul, sprouting mutated fungal blooms and warping the native beasts of the caverns into ravenous deviate horrors.

sections.title: Fallen Disciples
sections.body: The nightmare did not stop with the wildlife. Naralex's own disciples, driven completely mad by the psychic backlash bleeding out of their master's trance, broke away from the traditions of the Cenarion Circle. Casting aside their reverence for balance, they took on serpent forms and renamed themselves the Druids of the Fang. Believing their twisted growth must spread across Kalimdor, they now guard Naralex's slumbering body to ensure he never wakes, leaving only a lone loyal disciple named Muyoh searching for allies brave enough to break the trance.

faq.answer: Naralex is a night elf druid of the Cenarion Circle. He led an expedition into the Wailing Caverns with the goal of tapping into the Emerald Dream to turn the arid Barrens back into the lush forest it had been before the Sundering.

faq.q: Why is Naralex asleep inside the Wailing Caverns?
faq.answer: He entered a meditative trance to channel energies directly from the Emerald Dream into the underground aquifers beneath the Barrens. However, an overwhelming nightmare seized his mind, trapping him in a fevered slumber that he cannot wake from on his own.

faq.q: What created the Druids of the Fang?
aliases: who are druids of the fang
faq.answer: They were originally Naralex's faithful disciples. When the Emerald Nightmare corrupted Naralex's dream connection, the leaking malice drove his followers insane. They abandoned the Cenarion Circle, embraced serpent totems, and now protect his slumber to keep the corruption spreading.

faq.q: What caused the Wailing Caverns to mutate?
faq.answer: Naralex's sleeping body became an open conduit for the Emerald Nightmare. The foul dream energies seeped directly into the subterranean river system, warping the caverns' plants, crocodiles, raptors, and serpents into aggressive deviate mutants.

Yes, with outside help. His remaining loyal disciple, Muyoh, works with adventurers willing to enter the depths, slay the twisted Druids of the Fang, and perform a ritual to break the grip of the nightmare on Naralex's mind.

faq.q: Why did Naralex want to change the Barrens?
faq.answer: Naralex learned that the Barrens was once a flourishing forest before the Great Sundering shattered Kalimdor. He saw its current arid condition as an ecological wound and wished to restore its ancient verdant canopy.

angles.text: Naralex serves as a grim cautionary tale to druids: meddling blindly with primal natural states or tapping too deeply into the Dream without caution can unleash catastrophic perversions of the wild.
While Naralex sought to heal Kalimdor, his unchecked ambition deep in Horde territory brought disgrace to the Cenarion Circle and spawned the treacherous Druids of the Fang.
The twisted waters beneath the Barrens pose an immediate threat to the oasis pools and wildlife that sustain the tribes of Mulgore and the savannah.
A night elf's failed mystical experiment has polluted the heart of the Barrens, forcing Horde forces from the Crossroads to deal with the rampaging beasts boiling up from the cavern.
